_comment: Who we are and which tags mean what. The kickoff-wave settings below are unused: this agent runs leads, not waves.
_mailing_address: The company's postal address, printed in the footer of every email (CAN-SPAM). Read from env FMM_MAILING_ADDRESS (set at intake). Live email is refused until it is set; texts don't need it.
_attribution_tag_prefix: A reply tags the partner <prefix>:replied, a recorded deal <prefix>:deal-submitted (the send gate adds <prefix>:crm-sent). Empty = no attribution tags.
_program_tags: GHL lowercases tags, so these are lowercase. cohort: every partner the agent manages; the agent's sweeps, waves, reports and cards only ever see contacts with this tag (the sub-account holds many other contacts). source: where the record came from. Both go on at import. campaign: enrollment in the reactivation campaign; NOT added at import (a GHL workflow triggers on it), only by `fcm program enroll` once the copy is approved. Empty cohort = no filter. later: a partner who said "later" (W-8b holds them 60 days). hot: a warm reply (a call, a deal, will send deals, wants help): the positive-replies smart list. manager: a reply Justin leads (a deal, a call, a question, commissions, "is this a real person?", a service); GHL's W-10 texts and emails him on it. The agent answers every other reply itself, by text or email.
